course_info.trial_description:
Fun Grammar Lessons for young learners and Grammar Practice for adults

My Grammar Practice for adults worksheets are filled with useful, everyday language that will boost your grammar skills and help you develop your fluency. Each lesson includes a variety of reading, writing and speaking tasks activities on a particular grammar target. These lessons are a lifeline for any student looking for extra ways to reinforce a specific grammar point.

Fun Grammar Lessons teach young learners the building blocks of English with kid-friendly lessons that are full of pictures and fun activities. Each lesson includes simple grammar notes and exercises that will help introduce and develop core grammar skills required for fluency. 

I also have Grammar Assessment Tests to determine your current English level. 

Grammar Test 1-Beg: a low or mid-range score indicates that students should use our beginner-level materials. A high score indicates that they can use low-intermediate or intermediate materials. 

Grammar Test 2-Low Int: a low or mid-range score indicates that students should use our beginner or low-intermediate materials. A high score indicates that they can use intermediate materials. 

Grammar Test 3 – Int: it is recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1 and 2 before trying Test 3. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 3 indicates that students should use our intermediate-level materials. A high score indicates that they may be ready for high-intermediate or advanced materials. 

Grammar Test 4 - High Int – Adv: it is also recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1, 2, and 3 before trying Test 4. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 4 indicates that students should use our intermediate – high-intermediate materials. A high score indicates that they can use advanced materials as well as authentic reading and listening materials.

pro_course_detail.title: Professional Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency!
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to improve your conversational English in a low stress environment? 
Want to improve your fluency and speak English with more confidence?

Do you feel like you understand grammar better than you can speak? These lessons are designed for you! 

During our time together we will have a relaxed conversation about topics important to you. These lessons focus on pronunciation, fluency, learning to speak with confidence, being able to articulate what you want to say, and help improve your listening skills as we speak American English together. 

We can focus on either social conversation, or more professional style conversation, depending on your needs. These lessons do not have homework and the goal of these lessons is to remain relaxed.

I will typically not make many corrections during our time together in order to not break the conversational fluency practice. (I will make corrections during the lesson upon request of the student, and also if there is a repeating error which is hindering our time).

These lessons are for all levels of English and a trial lesson is not needed.

* The primary difference between professional and social English is whether colloquial speech is used. Colloquial speech is basically “common slang” which is very common in movies, music, and among friends, but not usually appropriate in a professional setting.

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading – University Papers and Professional Documents
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have a university or professional paper in need of proofreading?

While I am not able to write or re-write papers for you, I will correct spelling, grammar, and offer suggestions when a sentence is not worded naturally. I will always grade for spelling and grammar, while word choice will be graded based on the individual's English level. (English levels A1-native)

You will need to send me the paper in advance of the lesson as an attachment so that I am able to proofread your document. Please note that all papers require that I am given the paper at least 5 work days in advance of the lesson. However, the true length of time needed will only be given after you are able to provide me with the paper. This is because the amount of time I need for proofreading depends on the topic as well as your personal English level and ability.

You must also send the paper in a workable format so that I can make edits. (As in, not a PDF). A short explanation of the goal of the paper is also needed. 

As soon as I receive the document, I will immediately open it and respond to you confirming that I can open the document. If I cannot open the document, I will respond immediately requesting a different format. I will then return the corrected paper back to you by the time of the scheduled lesson.

Please note that an hour lesson is up to 1000 words. (This is a little over a 4 page paper double spaced in 12 point Times New Roman font). 

If the paper is longer, you are able to book additional hours to cover the correct word count. (For example, up to 1000 words requires an hour lesson, up to 2000 words requires two hours to be booked,  up to 3000 words requires 3 hours to be booked, etc.)

Please keep in mind that an hour lesson is for the time spent making corrections. If you would like to additionally discuss the corrections over Skype, please consult my “Discussion of University and Professional Papers” class. I appreciate your understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Discussion of University and Professional Papers
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to discuss proofreading corrections over Skype video or chat?
Would you like to discuss grammatical corrections you received from a professor at your school?
Would you like to discuss another document to receive a native perspective?
This course is for you!

This course has two main focuses. The first focus is discussing corrections which either I or another professor had given you. The second focus is discussing questions you have concerning your own edits.

Please be sure to send me the document prior to the lesson as either an email or Skype attachment. You must also send the paper in a workable format so that I can make edits. (As in, not a PDF).

As soon as I receive the document, I will immediately open it and respond to you confirming that I can open the document. If I cannot open the document, I will respond immediately requesting a different format.

Please note that this lesson is intended to discuss corrections over Skype in either chat or video. If you would like me to professionally proofread your paper, please consult my other “Proofreading Papers” class. I appreciate your understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Perfect Pronunciation Drilling!
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for advanced speakers of English. If you are able to speak fluently, but your accent is simply not improving, this class is designed for you.

This is an intensive class which helps you improve your accent and your ability to pronounce words naturally and correctly. 

Areas we will address include:
- articulation (the actual pronunciation of words)
- intonation (the rise and fall of your voice)
- stress (the emphasis of words)

During this class you will need to read a text. I will provide the text for us to review, but if you have your own text which you would like to read, please keep in mind that your text will need to be at least two pages long and I will need a copy of your text at least 24 hours in advance.

Please also keep in mind that this class is not designed to improve your conversation skills or fluency. This class strictly focuses on your pronunciation in order to reduce your accent. 

If you are interested in improving your speaking ability so that you are able to speak with more confidence and fluency, you are looking for my “Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency” class. 

My “Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency” class also addresses your accent and pronunciation, but unlike this class, it is additionally designed to improve your speaking ability overall, with a focus on improving your confidence and fluency.

I combine this meaningful conversation with cultural exchange because I believe that understanding the culture behind the language you are learning is just as important as language acquisition. I also provide my students with extra practice outside of the lessons such as watching videos, doing listening exercises and listening to music because I believe that being exposed to native input is the next best thing after communicating with native speakers. I hope to see you on the other side of my computer screen soon! I can't wait for us to begin this language learning journey together!

pro_course_detail.title: The Best Way to Learn Spanish! — Learn Spanish through Comprehensible Input and Interaction!
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Hola a todos!

Are you ready to learn Spanish through Comprehensible Input? I mean really acquire, understand and produce the Spanish language at your own pace? Well these are the lessons for you! Whether you are have a little experience, some experience or absolutely no experience with the Spanish language, this approach will help you acquire Spanish in a fun and meaningful way. 

What is Comprehensible Input (C.I.) anyway? Comprehensible Input simply refers to words and phrases that you can understand in another language through reading and/or listening at any given moment. I teach using solely this method so that you don't have to worry about boring textbooks, memorizing grammar rules or vocabulary lists or any of the painfully ineffective teaching methods you experienced in high school or college. 

Each class will be specially designed to suit your needs. During these classes we will focus on all four language skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking). I will provide all of the materials for you each class. There will be articles, photo/video description activities, songs and song lyric activities, writing activities, games and much more! 

These lessons are recommended for students who really want to be immersed into the Spanish language and the culture surrounding it. 

So, are you ready to start your Spanish journey and enjoy every moment of it? Book a class and experience a Spanish class that you've always wanted, but never knew existed!

¡Nos vemos pronto! 
(See you soon!)

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Coaching— Acquire an American Accent!
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you desirous of improving your accent in order to become more understandable to others? Would you like to sound more like a native English speaker from the United States?

This course is for you!

I will take you step by step through the basic sounds, vowels, and consonants that make up the American accent. Not only will your accent improve with time, but you will learn a lot about why the American accent sounds the way that it does. 

You will also learn about regional variances in the American accent like California, New York, the Midwest etc.

The only requirements for taking this course are the following:

1. You are mentally prepared to receive corrections. Sometimes receiving corrections can feel uncomfortable at first. However, if you remember that these corrections are to help you improve, you will achieve your goals.

By actively participating in these lessons, you will be making important steps towards improving your American English pronunciation skills. I will give you useful corrections during and after our lessons so that you can improve gradually. 

Give accent coaching a try. Your future self will thank you!

We will discuss a wide variety of topics so that you can get comfortable talking about many different subjects. Along the way, I will give you corrections and suggest new vocabulary and expressions to help you better express yourself. We will also focus on grammar, pronunciation, and intonation to help you sound more natural. Conversations may be free-flowing or focus on a specific topic, and we will sometimes read short articles to learn new vocabulary in context, and give us another subject to discuss. 

If there is anything you would like to focus on, such as grammar, something you would like to learn, such as common expressions, or a topic you would like to discuss, please always feel free to let me know. I want to help you meet your goals, whatever they may be, and to ensure our class time is enjoyable for you. I always welcome suggestions, requests, and feedback.
